purpose: Minimal handoff separating the proved reductions from the unresolved all-C reflected-pair conjecture. This file does not upgrade numerical diagnostics to certificates.
model: p(x)=A+B cos(x)+C sin(x), B^2+C^2<=min(A,1-A)^2. Take C>0 by reflection; z=cos(x), s=sqrt(1-z^2), p_plus=A+Bz+Cs, p_minus=A+Bz-Cs.

proved_reductions.claim: Every reflection pair gives an exact achievable oracle information value.
proved_reductions.detail: For f(p)=p log(p)+(1-p)log(1-p), let q_c=logistic((f(p_plus)-f(p_minus))/(p_plus-p_minus)). The two KL values to q_c coincide at R(z). The plus-arm weight omega=(q_c-p_minus)/(p_plus-p_minus) has weighted mean q_c, so the minimizing common null is q_c. Thus V>=R_star=max_z R(z).

proved_reductions.claim: Pointwise KL intervals overlap at radius R_star.
proved_reductions.detail: Let ell_R(p) and u_R(p) be the lower and upper endpoints of {q:kl(p||q)<=R}. Their monotonicity in p implies that the common interval for p_minus and p_plus is [L(z),U(z)], with L=ell_R_star(p_plus), U=u_R_star(p_minus). Since R_star>=R(z), L(z)<=U(z). At any capacity maximizer z_star, both equal q_c(z_star).

proved_reductions.claim: The proposed global curvature statement would prove the full conjecture.
proved_reductions.detail: If L is concave and U is convex on [-1,1], a common supporting tangent at an interior contact z_star satisfies L(z)<=q_t(z)<=U(z) for all z. Its endpoints are in [0,1], so q_t=a+bz is physical. Both KL branches are then <=R_star globally. This gives V<=R_star and matches the reflected design. In a differentiable interior model, L'(z_star)=U'(z_star)=partial_z q_c(z_star), so the line is precisely the entropy-center tangent null. Boundary models require endpoint/subgradient or limiting treatment.

proved_reductions.claim: The lower-envelope curvature can be written explicitly.
proved_reductions.detail: For 0<q=ell_R(p)<p<1, K=q(1-q)(logit(p)-logit(q))/(p-q). Then ell_R'=K and ell_R''=[1/(p(1-p))-2K/(q(1-q))+(p/q^2+(1-p)/(1-q)^2)K^2]q(1-q)/(p-q). Thus L''=ell_R''(B-Cz/s)^2-K C/s^3. The upper-envelope problem is the probability-complemented lower-envelope problem.

proved_reductions.claim: A positive-information two-support design with an interior minimizing affine null must use reflected angles.
proved_reductions.detail: The two null score equations are g1+g2=0 and z1*g1+z2*g2=0, where gi=wi(qi-pi)/(qi(1-qi)). If z1 differs from z2 both scores vanish, so each qi=pi and the information is zero. This does not exclude three or more supports or a boundary minimizer.

proved_special_regimes.result: Balanced PSR is globally optimal with value Phi(2C).
Constant Bernoulli capacity-center null dominates the entire probability interval by convexity of KL in p. The PSR pair with capacity weights is globally optimal.

proved_special_regimes.regime: Each fixed 0<A<1 and |B|<min(A,1-A), sufficiently small nonzero |C|
proved_special_regimes.result: Unique capacity maximizer and its tangent null give an exact globally optimal reflected pair. No numeric epsilon or uniform boundary neighborhood has been proved.
The model is a null and V=0.

unresolved: Prove L''<=0 and U''>=0 globally at R_star for every interior physical model, or replace the curvature claim by a weaker direct affine-separation proof.
If the curvature claim fails, distinguish failure of this sufficient proof route from an actual counterexample to reflected-pair optimality.
Control limiting models whose Bernoulli rates reach zero or one, and capacity contacts approaching z=+/-1.
Exclude genuinely better designs with three or more supports, including those whose minimizing affine null is on the physical boundary.
Obtain a paid-learning rule and finite-risk finite-cost analysis before interpreting any oracle information theorem as an operational improvement.
Perform independent novelty and literature comparison before claiming a new theorem or SOTA result.
known_nonproofs: Joint convexity of Bernoulli KL alone does not give the needed envelope curvature.
The analogous curvature assertion is false for unrestricted large radii; the link R=R_star must be used.
Treating A*I+B*Z+C*X as a trace-one qubit state is invalid when A differs from 1/2.
A finite mesh without a counterexample does not establish all-angle domination.
The six 120-digit weak-signal checks verify algebra and stationary contacts, not a numerical epsilon.

retained_numerical_evidence.scope: The retained 48-model registry did not reveal a robust reflected-pair counterexample. It is not a certified continuum bound. No new counterexample scan is started by this checklist.

claim_boundary: The unrestricted all-C conjecture remains unresolved. These analytic information statements do not evade the previously certified finite-cost threefold-speedup obstructions, do not establish finite-budget superiority, and do not by themselves support a SOTA claim.
